versions.changelog: Removed horizontal rules for cleaner documentation
SEO improvements: keyword-rich description, searchable name, keywords block for better ClawdHub discoverability
Added reactions, mark as read, example responses, more API endpoints, default env vars, author info

Initial release of Claw Me Maybe (v1.0.0):

- Adds Beeper integration: search, send, and manage messages across 12+ chat platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, and more) from a single skill.
- Supports user-invocable actions: search chats, send messages, summarize inbox, set reminders, and download attachments via Beeper's Desktop API.
- Clear setup instructions for connecting Beeper and using access tokens.
- Includes technical usage tips, troubleshooting steps, and direct API example commands.
- Emphasizes privacy: all API calls are local to your machine.
